items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: But one day, he brought a Mamie Smith or a Bessie Smith record

ctx.x: So sometimes my dad would bring records from the furniture store and he didn't know what he was bringing. So, you know what I mean. If he brought Blue Heaven, he thought that was great because he liked Blue Heaven, see? Or if he
brought some church songs, that was great, you know? But one day, he brought a Mamie Smith or a Bessie Smith record --
